models.name: todo_users
models.description: Registered user accounts with email/password credentials and authentication metadata. Each user has a unique email address and password hash stored using bcrypt. All personal data is isolated at user level with strict privacy enforcement.

plainFields.name: email
plainFields.description: User's email address for authentication and verification. Must be unique across all users.

plainFields.name: password_hash
plainFields.description: Password hash stored using bcrypt with work factor 12. Never stores plaintext passwords.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the user account was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the user account was last updated (password changes, profile updates, etc.).

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the user account was soft-deleted. Null means active account.

models.name: todo_user_sessions
models.description: JWT session tokens with access/refresh support and token expiry management. Tracks user login sessions for authentication lifecycle and session validity. Associated with the user actor through foreign key relationship.

foreignFields.name: todo_user_id
foreignFields.description: User this session belongs to. {@link todo_users.id}.

plainFields.name: ip
plainFields.description: IP address where session was created.

plainFields.name: href
plainFields.description: Original URL from which session was created.

plainFields.name: referrer
plainFields.description: Referrer URL for the session.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when session was created.

plainFields.name: expired_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when session expires and is automatically invalidated.

models.name: todo_user_password_resets
models.description:
Records password reset tokens with 60-minute expiration and usage tracking for user authentication flows. Handles secure token generation, validation, and cleanup.

This table is managed through user authentication services without direct user interaction, requiring:
- Unique token generation for each reset attempt
- 60-minute time-based expiration
- Usage tracking to prevent token reuse
- Secure storage of token values for verification

foreignFields.name: todo_user_id
foreignFields.description: User account associated with this password reset request. {@link todo_users.id}.

plainFields.name: token
plainFields.description: Unique token string for password reset verification.

plainFields.name: expires_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when token expires (60-minute validity).

plainFields.name: used_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when token was successfully used to reset password.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Entry creation timestamp.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Last modification timestamp.

models.name: todo_user_email_verifications
models.description:
Email verification tokens with 15-minute expiration for user account verification. Stores unique tokens, target email, expiration timestamp, and related to user account.

This is a subsidiary entity managed through the parent user account, not requiring independent CRUD endpoints. The token is auto-generated, unique, and expires after 15 minutes as required by authentication process.

foreignFields.name: todo_user_id
foreignFields.description: User account associated with this email verification token. {@link todo_users.id}.

plainFields.name: token
plainFields.description: Unique verification token for email confirmation. Generated as random string, stored hashed.

plainFields.name: expires_at
plainFields.description: Token expiration timestamp (15 minutes from creation). Required for security and session management.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the verification token was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the verification token was last modified.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the verification token was soft-deleted.

models.name: todo_system_configs
models.description:
System-wide configuration parameters including email templates, timeouts, and feature flags. Manages application-wide settings like email templates, expiration timeouts, and feature toggles.

This table stores all system-level parameters that affect application behavior and user experience, including:
- Email verification timeout (15 minutes as per requirements)
- Password reset timeout (60 minutes as per requirements)
- Feature flags toggle for enabling/disabling features

plainFields.name: email_verification_timeout
plainFields.description: Time in minutes for email verification links to expire (e.g., 15).

plainFields.name: password_reset_timeout
plainFields.description: Time in minutes for password reset tokens to expire (e.g., 60).

plainFields.name: feature_flags
plainFields.description: Serialized JSON string of feature flags enabled for the application.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the configuration record was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the configuration record was last updated.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the configuration record was soft-deleted. Nullable for soft delete handling.

models.name: todo_audit_logs
models.description:
System-wide audit log entries tracking all system-level events including user account changes and administrative actions.

Each audit entry records the event type, description, user context, and timestamp for complete historical tracing of system activities.

foreignFields.name: todo_user_id
foreignFields.description: User who performed the audit event. {@link todo_users.id}.

plainFields.name: event_type
plainFields.description: Type of the audit event (e.g., 'user.created', 'account.deleted').

plainFields.name: event_description
plainFields.description: Description of the audit event, with additional context if needed.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the audit log entry was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the audit log entry was last updated.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the audit log entry was soft-deleted (if applicable).

models.name: todo_todos
models.description: Core todo items that users create, view, edit, and manage. Includes required title, optional description, start date, due date, completion status, and soft delete tracking. Each todo item belongs to a single user account with strict user-data isolation enforced.

foreignFields.name: todo_user_id
foreignFields.description: Belongs to the user's account via {@link todo_users.id}.

plainFields.name: title
plainFields.description: Title of the todo item. Minimum 1 character required.

plainFields.name: description
plainFields.description: Optional description of the todo item.

plainFields.name: start_date
plainFields.description: Start date for the todo item.

plainFields.name: due_date
plainFields.description: Due date for completing the todo item.

plainFields.name: is_completed
plainFields.description: Completion status. Defaults to false on creation.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp of when the todo item was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp of the last update to the todo item.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp of soft deletion. Nullable for active items.

models.name: todo_histories
models.description: Detailed record of all field modifications including timestamps, previous values, and new values for each todo edit. Each history entry captures atomic changes to title, description, start date, and due date fields when a todo is modified.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the edit was recorded.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp of the last update to the history record (should match created_at for immutability).

plainFields.name: prev_title
plainFields.description: Previous title value before edit. Null if title was not changed.

plainFields.name: new_title
plainFields.description: New title value after edit. Null if title was not changed.

plainFields.name: prev_description
plainFields.description: Previous description value before edit. Null if description was not changed.

plainFields.name: new_description
plainFields.description: New description value after edit. Null if description was not changed.

plainFields.name: prev_start_date
plainFields.description: Previous start date value before edit. Null if start date was not changed.

plainFields.name: new_start_date
plainFields.description: New start date value after edit. Null if start date was not changed.

plainFields.name: prev_due_date
plainFields.description: Previous due date value before edit. Null if due date was not changed.

plainFields.name: new_due_date
plainFields.description: New due date value after edit. Null if due date was not changed.

models.name: todo_profiles
models.description: Stores user display names with maximum 20 character limit and no special characters. Display names are required for user identification and must comply with business rules regarding length and character usage.

plainFields.name: display_name
plainFields.description: User's display name shown to other users, must be between 1-20 characters with no special characters (alphabetic and numeric allowed).

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the profile was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the profile was last updated.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the profile was soft-deleted. Nullable for future soft delete implementation.
